WITH ny_hotels AS (
    SELECT
        h."id" AS hotel_id,
        h."name" AS hotel_name,
        c."name" AS city_name
    FROM
        "hotel" h
    JOIN
        "city" c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
    WHERE
        LOWER(TRIM(c."name")) = 'new york'
),

swimming_pool_hotels AS (
    SELECT
        h.hotel_id,
        h.hotel_name
    FROM
        ny_hotels h
    JOIN
        "roomtype" rt ON h.hotel_id = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN
        "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN
        "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE
        LOWER(TRIM(lf."feature")) = 'swimming pool'
    GROUP BY
        h.hotel_id, h.hotel_name
),

hot_tub_hotels AS (
    SELECT
        h.hotel_id,
        h.hotel_name
    FROM
        ny_hotels h
    JOIN
        "roomtype" rt ON h.hotel_id = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN
        "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN
        "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE
        LOWER(TRIM(lf."feature")) = 'hot tub'
    GROUP BY
        h.hotel_id, h.hotel_name
)

SELECT
    'Swimming Pool Hotels' AS feature_type,
    sp.hotel_name AS hotel_name
FROM
    swimming_pool_hotels sp

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Hot Tub Hotels' AS feature_type,
    ht.hotel_name AS hotel_name
FROM
    hot_tub_hotels ht;

SELECT

    r."customer_reviews" AS "review_text",
    r."number_of_stars" AS "stars_assigned",
    r."date_of_review" AS "review_date"
FROM
    "reviews" r
JOIN
    "hotels" h ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"

    "customers" c ON r."customerid" = c."customerid"
ORDER BY
    h."hotelid", r."date_of_review" DESC NULLS LAST;

GROUP BY
    c."customerid", c."fullname"
